# BH00008 (Unnamed)

*Translated on 17 Qudrat 183 using GPT 6.1 Sol*

**1** In the name of our Lord, the Most Holy, the Most Great, the All-Glorious.

**2** Praise be to God, who has fulfilled the promise, sent down the Promised One from the heaven of His will, and revealed what was inscribed by His Most Exalted Pen in His books, scriptures, writings, and tablets. The Resurrection has arisen, the Hour has come, the Path has appeared, the breeze of God has blown, and the fragrance of His garment has spread, despite the people of the Bayán, who have broken God’s covenant and pledge and have desired that you build the houses of conjecture and delusion with the hands of oppression and tyranny, as they built them before. Perish they; may they be crushed and banished! People of delusion! The Most Exalted Horizon has shone forth, and there has appeared what neither the veils of your own selves nor your delusions conceal. He has appeared with a sovereignty of His own and has torn through the veils of glory and concealment with the fingers of power, so that the Concourse on high has heard the sound of their rending. Fear God, you who are heedless! Do not turn people away from the path or keep them from the Guide. This is a day on which the ocean of knowledge has surged and the fragrance of God, the All-Protecting, the Self-Subsisting, has spread. Fear God, and do not seek to refute the truth through your words and deeds. This servant counsels you for the sake of God; every fair-minded, discerning person bears witness to this.

**3** And blessings, peace, exaltation, and glory be upon those who have drunk the choice wine of steadfastness, arisen to serve the Cause with wisdom and eloquence, and testified to what the Tongue of Grandeur testified before the creation of all things. These are servants whom God has described in the Qur’an and in the Bayán. Blessed is the one with an ear who has heard, and the one with sight who has seen; and woe to every scheming deceiver who has taken delusion as his lord instead of God and keeps people from the sweet waters of the mercy of their Lord, the Ever-Forgiving, the All-Bountiful.

**4** I respectfully submit that your letter reached this transient servant. After reading it and learning its contents, I proceeded to the abode of the Lord of Creation and entered His presence. After permission was granted, the contents of the letter were honored with His hearing, and these exalted words descended from the heaven of the grace of the Revealer of Verses. His words—exalted be His glory:

**5** I am the Wronged One, the Stranger.

**6** You who gaze toward the Face! Your letter is before the Wronged One, and the servant in attendance has presented it in full. Praise be to God, you have drunk the choice wine of recognition and turned toward the horizon of the All-Merciful in days when hearts and souls are agitated by the oppression of those who associate partners with God, and the pillars of the House are shaken by the tyranny of the religious scholars. At the beginning of every revelation, they turned away from the Manifestation of God and the Dawning-Place of divine revelation, and issued decrees for the shedding of the blood of those holy souls.

**7** Who brought about the departure of the Seal of the Prophets—may the souls of all besides Him be sacrificed for Him—from Mecca, and what was its cause? And at whose hands did the Spirit ascend to the fourth heaven? He was so sorely afflicted that the hand of power raised Him up and carried Him to the fourth heaven. With turbans and robes they bound the True One with the utmost oppression and tyranny, and in His name opened for themselves the door to honor and wealth. If assured souls reflect on the events of the past, by the life of God, they will lament and weep over the Wronged One of the world like those bereaved.

**8** At the time of Our departure from Zawrá, We informed everyone that clamor would rise throughout the world. All remained behind the veil in fear and agitation, while the True One alone arose for the Cause. When the radiance of the light of the sun of divine unity shone forth and the world became somewhat bright and illumined, they emerged from behind the veil and first objected to the True One Himself, and arose with the swords of rejection to shed His pure blood. Such is the way of the people. Take heed, you who possess understanding! You who are aflame with the fire of the love of God! Praise the Beloved of the world, for you have attained an abiding, everlasting blessing: the mention of you that has flowed from the Most Exalted Pen. Whatever is seen will assuredly perish, except a word uttered by the True One, exalted be His glory. Ask God to confirm you in what befits His Day. The treasuries of the earth and its buried riches cannot equal a single word of His. Give thanks and say: “Praise be to You, You who have remembered me; and all acclaim be to You, in whose hand are the reins of the kingdom of dominion over the heavens and the earth.” Here ends the quotation.

**9** What more can this servant say? God bears witness that his limbs are trembling and his heart is troubled, for it is evident that in every age and century certain ignorant servants, imagining themselves learned, have objected to the Dawning-Places of the light of divine unity and have striven with the utmost obstinacy to extinguish the divine light. Then, when the Cause became exalted, they would seize it with both hands and, by means of asceticism, take hold of the reins of the people, as you have seen and heard. They have their counterparts and their like in these days. Souls who had no knowledge whatever of this Cause have now arisen in oppression and tyranny, have claimed complete knowledge, and are keeping weak souls from the divine waterside, urging and encouraging them toward a stagnant, foul-smelling pool. May God protect His servants and preserve them from the whisperings of those souls, namely, the hypocrites among the people of the Bayán. May God shelter us and you, believers in His unity, from their evil.

**10** This transient servant asks and hopes that God, exalted be His glory, will confirm His loved ones, so that they may drink from the ocean of the meanings of the divine words and be so enkindled by the fire blazing within them that the promptings of devils will not keep them from the Lord of the Day of Judgment. In Káf and Rá a clamor has risen, and the source of conjecture and hypocrisy, with the utmost cunning and deceit and with fabricated words, has kept weak souls from the Lord of Oneness and is summoning them toward the liars, although he has never had, and does not now have, any knowledge of this Cause. Out of sheer desire he has taken exception to the Lord of Names and wanders bewildered in the wilderness of delusions. I ask God to guide him, not to deprive him of the choice wine of meanings and the flowing spring of truthfulness, and to grant him a share of the ocean of awareness. He is powerful and mighty over all things.

**11** In the Most Holy Book, which descended from the holy, divine Kingdom in the early days of the imprisonment, mention of the land of Káf and Rá and what would occur there flowed from the Most Exalted Pen and was recorded, and until now has remained concealed. Yet the clamorer of that land has this year uttered words at which the heavens have almost split apart, the earth rent asunder, and the mountains fallen flat.

**12** May God grant fairness and bestow justice and truthfulness. People like those souls summoned the people to Jábulqá and Jábulsá for twelve hundred years, indeed longer. Whenever an enlightened soul rejected this assertion and informed the people that the Qá’im was in the loins of His forebears and must be born, they issued a decree for his death and shed his blood. I swear by the Sun of the horizon of the All-Merciful’s utterance that this very clamorer of the land of Káf and Rá is among those souls, for he follows in their footsteps. How many holy souls drank the cup of martyrdom at the decree of those heedless, ignorant souls! All the loved ones and friends of God bear witness to the truth of what has been stated. They imagined that they were aiding the Cause of God and guiding people to the straight way, whereas that way was the way of hell, not the straight path.

**13** What intoxication has seized the people that, even now, they have not become aware of the deceit and cunning of the band of hypocrites? Please alert the friends of God to protect themselves, in the name of God, exalted be His glory, from the embodiments of guile and hypocrisy and the sources of deception and deceit, and not to place their trust in those people. For it is observed that when they lose hope of someone—that is, when they see that their delusions have neither taken hold of him nor influenced him—they assume the guise of friendship and outwardly associate with him with the utmost love and affection. Their purpose is to find an opportunity to instill what lies concealed in their hearts. Avoidance is necessary in every circumstance. Through the means of friendship they strengthen the foundations of enmity. Their approach is rejection, their kindness hostility, their silence deception, and their speech deceit.

**14** Say: \[corrupted original text\] foolish ones, the riders in the arena of detachment today see none but God, recognize none but God, and speak of none but God, for this day is the Day of God, in which none is mentioned but Him. Today, if a soul speaks of anyone other than God and turns his gaze toward imaginary names, he has never been, and is not, worthy of this station, this mention, and this Cause. Say: Heedless ones, fear God and do not ensnare the helpless people. Let them fly in this atmosphere on the wings of detachment and enter this court with the utmost joy. If only the people would recognize and understand! Some time ago, in one of the Tablets, this exalted utterance flowed from the tongue of the Lord of all creation and was sent down. His words—blessed and exalted be He:

**15** O servant in attendance, do these people not reflect on the greatness of this Day? Today is a day whose greatness has been mentioned and recorded by the Most Exalted Pen in all the divine Books. Although the days of the appearance of the Manifestations of divine unity and the Dawning-Places of divine light are, in one sense, called the Days of God, these days have been singled out in all the Books and belong especially to God, exalted be His glory. Thus He says to the Seal of the Prophets: “The day when the people will stand before the Lord of the worlds”; and likewise: “Sovereignty on that day belongs to God”; and “Your Lord comes, and the angels, rank upon rank,” and other such statements. And to Him who conversed with God He says: “Bring the people out of darkness into light, and remind them of the Days of God.” He gives all the Messengers the glad tidings of this blessed Day. Nevertheless, at one time they speak of a mirror, at another of a successor, and at another of a fruit. They cling to these names and are unaware. They speak without awareness; they utter words without understanding. Say: “Die in your rage! This is the Day of God, if only you recognized it, and this is the Cause of God, if only you judged fairly. He who was concealed in the knowledge of God and recorded in His Books has appeared, and through Him every sealed matter and every hidden secret has been disclosed.” End of quotation.

**16** Now, such is the baseness of these souls that a fly has raised objections against the Lord of lords. The raven has no share in the realm of inner meanings, and the fly has no portion of the divine melodies. This arena calls for the horsemen of spiritual knowledge to spur on the steed of endeavor in the name of God, exalted be His glory. Glory be to God! Some souls have spoken, and continue to speak, out of sheer desire, for they have drunk the wine of delusions and taken someone other than God as their lord. They move amid the winds of conjecture and lead people astray with their imaginings. If this servant were to relate what he has heard concerning these matters, pages of discourse would certainly not suffice. The verses revealed in the Most Holy Book upon first entering the prison are cited here, so that perhaps the heedless may become aware, the sleeping may awaken, and those who sit idle may arise. His words—mighty is His utterance and exalted His station:

**17** O land of Kaf and Ra! We see you in a state displeasing to God, and We see from you what none but God, the All-Knowing, the All-Aware, has perceived. We discern what proceeds from you in the deepest secrecy. With Us is the knowledge of all things in a clear Tablet. Do not grieve over this. God will raise up within you people of great might who will remember Me with a steadfastness that neither the allusions of the learned can hinder nor the doubts of the doubters veil. They will surely behold God with their own eyes and aid Him with their own selves. Truly, he is among the steadfast. End of quotation.

**18** These verses were revealed when there was no mention of the clamorer of that land, and the Most Holy Book was revealed ten years before that, as everyone knows. Ignorant souls have always adorned themselves with cloaks and turbans and, in the guise of learning, barred its door. Which of their traditions, sayings, and reports has proved true and accorded with reality? Because of the ignorance of those heedless souls, the hapless people have wandered for centuries in the wilderness of delusions and conjectures. In any event, this is said for the sake of God, so that perhaps they may not rebuild the structure of delusion or lay the foundations of conjecture upon the earth.

**19** Today they must, through the power of the Friend of all the world, break the chains of imitation and shatter the idols of delusion. They must purify their ears of what they have heard, leave discussions behind, and turn from words to deeds. Say: “O heedless ones, who arose to uphold the Cause, and who called everyone to the Most Exalted Horizon in days when the hearts of those endowed with understanding were shaken?” Glory be to God! What have they understood of this Day, and what have they perceived of this Most Great Revelation?

**20** This is a Day in which none is mentioned but Him, and no one should cling to likenesses, counterparts, or names. This is a Day whose praise the Books of God have voiced and to which the Prophets and Messengers have borne witness. One is bewildered as to what to say. The Shiite community considered itself greater, more learned, and more pious than all the communities of the world; yet in the radiance of the light of the Sun of Revelation, it became clear and evident that they are the lowest of communities, for it was by the ruling of those souls that the Beloved of all the worlds was martyred in the land of Ta. Truly, the curse of God rests upon the unjust people. Nor were they content with this: they issued a ruling for the killing of all the holy souls. How many children and women were martyred through the oppression of those souls, and how many were left without a home, a refuge, or anyone to care for them!

**21** Now a fresh gathering of the world’s liars has assembled, and they have been, and remain, intent on reconstructing the former foundations. The clamorer of the land of Kaf and Ra and the other clamorers intend to veil the light of the Sun of Truth with the clouds of new conjectures, and to spend another two or three thousand years rejecting and accepting, turning away and objecting, reviling and cursing one another from pulpits and in assemblies. I swear by the Sun of the horizon of holiness, this servant is ashamed and abashed to mention these things. All the divines of the age, each of whom was a leader in Iran and occupied a pulpit and a prayer niche, failed to perceive even a needle’s eye’s measure of the fragrance of truth. Had they perceived it, this new and unparalleled oppression would not have occurred in the world. Out of sheer desire and ambition for leadership, they uttered what became the cause and occasion of the martyrdom of the Desire of the world, the Primal Point—may the souls of all besides Him be sacrificed for Him. Had it not been for those fabricated statements, God and His loved ones would not have been martyred. In the first year, all the divines declared that the divines, earlier and later alike, had held that He must appear from Jabulqa and Jabulsa, whereas this community now said that He had been born in Shiraz. Thus they all pronounced Him an unbeliever and decreed the shedding of His pure blood.

**22** O beloved of my heart, some reflection is necessary, so that you may become aware of the oppression of this faction and alert others. Most people cling to imitation and are afflicted by desire. The flood of their conjectures and delusions has destroyed the foundation of faith. Fie upon them and those who have followed them! Their heedlessness has reached such a degree that, through their own imaginings, they have devised conditions for the Revelation and have confined Him within their own allusions and conceptions. When they found Him contrary to their conjectures, an uproar arose. Say:

**23** This Great Announcement has never needed, nor does He now need, anyone’s confirmation to establish His Cause. Consider, then, what the Point of the Bayan—may the souls of all within the realm of existence be sacrificed for Him—has uttered. His words, blessed and exalted be He: “I have written a jewel concerning His mention, namely that He is not to be consulted through My allusion, nor through what has been mentioned in the Bayan.” And further on, His words, glorified and mighty be He: “For He is too glorious and exalted to be known through anyone other than Himself or to seek counsel through the allusion of His creation. I am indeed the first servant to have believed in Him and \[corrupted original text\], and from the pristine gardens of the paradise of His recognition I have taken the gardens of His words. Yes, by His might! He is the Truth; there is no god but Him. All subsist through His command.” End of quotation.

**24** Where are the attentive ears, and where are the keen eyes, that they may behold the radiance of the light of the Sun of Utterance and hear the call of God, exalted be His glory? If all the people of the Bayan were to consider and reflect on this one passage with fairness and justice, they would all turn toward the Most Holy, disregard what is with people, and cling to what is with God. But what use is it, when the cotton of self-interest has prevented ears from hearing, and the veils of conjectures and delusions have kept eyes from seeing?

**25** On one occasion, this exalted utterance appeared and was revealed from the Dawning-Place of the revelation of the Lord of Names. His words, blessed and exalted be He: “O servant in attendance, consider: the eyelid, thin as it is seen to be, if it becomes a veil, leaves the eye deprived and prevented from beholding the heavens and the earth and all they contain—trees, rivers, seas, mountains, fruits, colors, and all that is with them. Now, if the thick veil of conjectures should fall upon the heart, what will it do? O servant in attendance, ask God to purify everyone of obstructing veils, so that perhaps they may discern the purpose of the creation of humankind, attain recognition of the hidden, sealed Treasure, and drink of this sealed choice wine.” End of quotation.

**26** In short, the essence of the Bayan, as confirmed by the Beloved of all the worlds, is that the Dawning-Place of the Verses and the Dayspring of Clear Proofs is not dependent on the allusion of that Sovereign of existence or on what was revealed in the Bayan, and that all are commanded to recognize Him through His own Self. Concerning this station, certain mysteries were heard from the tongue of the Dayspring of Names, which this servant does not dare to relate without permission. If only the people knew and recognized! Blessed is the soul who turns toward the Most Exalted Horizon with his own eyes and perceives the light of the Face without veils of glory or allusions.

**27** Intoxication with the wine of pride and heedlessness has veiled the majority. Of Him who is the pure Essence of eternity, concerning whom the Point of the Bayan—may the spirit of all else be sacrificed for Him—says, “I am indeed the first servant to have believed in Him and His verses,” they have said things that cause heaven to split apart and the kingdom of names to tremble. In truth, if anyone reflects on these blessed words that have shone from the Dayspring of the utterance of God, exalted be His glory, and discovers the pearls of His utterance, he will find himself rich and independent of all, soar on the wings of assurance in the holy atmosphere of the All-Merciful, and drink from the river of steadfastness. Today, if anyone hesitates for less than an instant, he is counted among the people of the fire. At His mention, all other mentions vanish, and before His utterance, every utterance bows.

**28** On one occasion He said: “O servant in attendance, today the kingdom of utterance bows in humble submission before the All-Merciful. All books and tablets depend upon His will and are subject to it, and all who are in the Bayan are commanded to turn to this Most Great Remembrance and momentous Announcement and to recognize Him. Blessed is the soul who, through the name of the Self-Subsisting, has broken the chains of vain imaginings and conjectures, passed beyond what is with the people, and held fast to what is with God.” End of quotation.

**29** There have always been people like those who turn away. If anyone reflects on the events following the passing of His Holiness ʿAskari, upon him be the peace of God, and on the intrigues of the godless religious scholars, he will testify that all the corruption in the world has come, and continues to come, from such people. By the life of our Lord! Were it not for the lies of the leaders, the Most Exalted Lord would not have been martyred through the oppression of His enemies. They appointed an imaginary personage to an imaginary throne and, through imaginary traditions, established what led to the shedding of the blood of the Lord of the world and the jewels of the nations. At times they produced forged rescripts and attributed them to the Source of existence. Indeed, may God's curse rest upon the people who lie! Inwardly, their aim was to enhance their own eminence and exaltation, but outwardly they pointed to \[corrupted original text\]—sometimes Jabulqa, sometimes Jabulsa, and sometimes the lying seat that they called holy. As for the everlasting Sovereign, the Point of the Bayan—may the spirit of all else be sacrificed for Him—says concerning Him, exalted be His remembrance: “He is too glorious and exalted to be known through anyone other than Himself or to seek counsel through the indications of His creatures.”

**30** Now heedless souls have arisen in opposition and have clung to the words of this person and that. Today the Tongue of Grandeur declares, exalted be His majesty: “O Pen, do you see anyone but Me today? Where are all things and their manifestations? Where are the names and their kingdom, the inward realities and their mysteries, the outward forms and their effects? Annihilation has overtaken all who dwell in creation, and this is My everlasting, radiant, luminous Face.” End of quotation.

**31** Now consider what they cling to and what cords they grasp. They intend to set up a new imaginary apparatus for the helpless people, like the vain imaginings of the past. Again I say: “May God protect us, O company of those who affirm His oneness, from the evil of these people.”

**32** In short, today no book among the books, no tablet among the tablets, and no scripture among the scriptures suffices. Glorified be God above what the wrongdoers say! Today all must look toward the horizon of the Revelation and whatever appears from Him. If a person occupies himself with vain imaginings, conjectures, and traditions, his end will assuredly be destruction, as has been seen.

**33** Glory be to You, O God of land and sea! You see me standing before You, with the hands of my hope raised toward the heaven of Your bounty and grace. I ask You, by Your sovereignty that overshadows all created things and by Your name through which You have subdued all contingent beings, to aid Your servants to act with justice and fairness. Enable them to turn toward You with Your sight and to look in Your direction through Your light. You are the One through whose name the seas of grace and bounty have surged, and through whose will the heaven of Your generosity has been adorned, O Lord of Names. There is no God but You, the All-Powerful, who chooses as He wills.

**34** If today anyone looks to anything other than God and His utterance, he will assuredly stray from the path and assuredly make his abode in hell. He says: “The entire Bayan is but a leaf among the leaves of His paradise, if it attains His acceptance.” Glory be to God! How lofty is the station of the Cause, and in what mud do these earthworms dwell! This mortal servant is bewildered. By God, the All-Protecting, the Self-Subsisting! From the beginning of the Cause until now, I have had, and still have, no thought but God's good pleasure. Now I have grown old and my strength has waned. Nevertheless, despite my pressing duties, I have occupied myself with this writing solely for the sake of God. God is witness and knows that I have sought, and still seek, nothing but His good pleasure. For His sake I have spoken, and for His sake I speak. Let whoever wishes turn toward Him, and whoever wishes turn away. Our Lord, the All-Merciful, is indeed the Self-Sufficient, the Praiseworthy.

**35** Reflect also on this exalted utterance revealed from the Dayspring of the utterance of the Lord of Names, namely the Primal Point—may the spirit of all else be sacrificed for Him. In truth, this utterance is to be counted among the very essence of His words. He, exalted be He, says: “In the year nine you will attain all good, and in the year nine you will be granted the presence of God.” And, addressing His Honor ʿAzim—upon him be the most resplendent of all glory and the loftiest of all exaltation—He, exalted be He, says:

**36** “This is what We promised you before, at the time when We answered you. Be patient until nine have elapsed from the Bayan; then say: ‘Blessed be God, the best of originators!’” Now judge fairly: who appeared in the year nine? Where are the ears, and where are the eyes? In short, there has never been, nor is there now, any refuge for anyone except to repent and return to God, the All-Protecting, the Self-Subsisting, unless he shuts his eyes to the heaven of proof, the sun of certitude, the Most Great Ocean, and the momentous Announcement. For such a person the divine verses and the Lord's clear proofs have been, and remain, fruitless. Every fair-minded person testifies that the Cause of God is manifest through this Most Great Revelation. In the days when all were occupied with preserving their lives and were concealed and hidden in corners, God, exalted be His glory, stood forth and spoke in His own Person, so that the spray from the ocean of His utterance has encompassed the world and His writings have embraced every horizon. Blessed are the fair-minded and those who listen.

**37** Likewise, the Primal Point—may the spirit of all else be sacrificed for Him—says: “Say: It is an announcement whose knowledge none but God has encompassed, yet on that day you will not know.” Despite this, these unfair people have said what they have said. This is that momentous Announcement mentioned and recorded in all the books, and no one but God Himself knows or is aware of the time of its appearance. This is the hour of which Jesus speaks and which He foretold: “But of that day and that hour no one knows, neither the angels in heaven nor the Son, but only the Father.” End of quotation.

**38** And this is the day of which Joel says in his book: “For the day of the Lord is great and very terrible; who can endure it?” Likewise Jeremiah says: “Alas, for that day is great, and none is like it.” Everything that has appeared is mentioned in the books of the Messengers, even the fortress that is now the seat of the throne and is called the Most Great Prison, as David says: “Who will lead me into the fortified city?” The fortified city is Akka, and its fortress is well known and renowned. This is the fortress of which he says that the lights of the Sun of Truth have shone upon it and risen from its horizon. Likewise, they gave one another and the inhabitants of this land the glad tidings that God would appear and reveal His splendor in these lands in the last days.

**39** Isaiah says: “Go up onto a high mountain, O herald of Zion. Lift up your voice with strength, O herald of Jerusalem. Lift it up, do not fear. Say to the cities of Judah: ‘Behold your God! Behold, the Lord God comes with power, and His arm rules for Him.’” Zion and Jerusalem are in these lands, and he says that it will be called by a new name, just as in the Land of Mystery it was named the Noble Valley by the Tongue of Grandeur. This is the valley in which the call of all the Prophets is raised and which proclaims: “Here I am, O God, here I am!” Abraham, Moses, Jesus, and the Seal of the Prophets—may the spirit of all who exist be sacrificed for them—appeared in these lands, for this land is connected to the land of Batha and the Hijaz. Thus He says: “Blessed is whoever migrates to Akka.” I swear by the Sun of the horizon of utterance that this mortal one's purpose has never been, nor is it now, to display knowledge, learning, or erudition. Rather, these things are set forth for the sake of God, so that heedless souls may not cause the people to be veiled, as they have done before. In short, these are the holy lands mentioned in the Quran and the earlier books, and in the book of the Prophet Amos, peace be upon him, he says:

**40** “The Lord roars from Zion and gives forth His voice from Jerusalem; the pastures of the shepherds mourn, and \[corrupted original text\] the summit of Carmel.” This Carmel lies opposite Akka and is called the Mound of God in the earlier books. Its mention has flowed from the Most Exalted Pen, and some have surely attained it. Among the things irrevocably ordained is that the tabernacle of glory should be raised upon it, and, praise be to God, it has been raised. From Zion flows the Euphrates of meanings, despite those who have cast aside fairness and embraced injustice.

**41** The greatness of the Revelation is such that David says in speaking of it: “Exalt the Lord our God and bow down at His footstool. Holy is He. Moses and Aaron are among His priests, and Samuel among those who call upon His name.” Now one must reflect deeply upon this blessed verse. Today all trees are enraptured, rocks and stones tremble and move, and the mountains pass along in the greatest joy, for the promised hour has come and the hidden treasure has been revealed. If this sublime word were removed from the books, no utterance would remain and no mention would be found. But this statement is for those endowed with insight and understanding, not for every base and ignorant person who leads the way in vain imaginings and conjectures.

**42** Today the sun of certainty has shone forth. It is another day, and these are other days, incomparable with any others. Yet eyes are diseased and inflamed, and ears are stopped. I ask the True One to bestow joy and not to deprive His creatures of this greatest joy. He also says: “\[corrupted original text\] comes and will not remain silent.”

**43** If this servant wished to quote from the earlier books and the utterances revealed in them, readers might grow weary of the length of the discourse. I have therefore firmly resolved to be as brief as possible. I ask those assured souls who are content and well-pleasing to remember me, so that through their prayers and remembrance I may fulfill what I have been charged to do and not fall short in serving the loved ones of the True One.

**44** Alas, alas! A Cause of such greatness, with this manifest power and dazzling might encompassing the world, yet people are veiled from beholding it and heedless of recognizing it. He is the Almighty of whom the Prophet Amos says: “Prepare to meet your God, O Israel. 13 For He is the One who formed the mountains, created the wind, and told humanity what His thought is; who makes the dawn darkness and walks upon the heights of the earth. Yahweh, the God of Hosts, is His name.” By the life of our Beloved and your Beloved, our Desire and your Desire! Great mysteries lie concealed in this mighty verse, for it foretells the appearance of eighty, and likewise the false dawn, which, He says, the God of Hosts darkens. He walks upon the heights of the earth, which alludes to the journey to the Great City and also to these regions.

**45** This servant is bewildered as to what satisfied people in the past and what satisfies them now. If they seek verses, these have filled the horizons; if they want clear proofs, it is for this servant to establish and display them. I swear by the True One Himself—may the spirits of all in the kingdoms of command and creation be sacrificed for Him—that great and wondrous things have appeared in this Revelation. Whatever occurred in successive years afterward had already flowed down and been revealed from the Most Exalted Pen, without cryptic language or allusion, but with complete explicitness. Every fair-minded person inhales the fragrance of truthfulness from these submissions, for whatever has been or is being set forth is supported by clear evidence and proof.

**46** If this servant wished to recount everything, the account would certainly grow lengthy. I will, however, briefly mention some of it for the sake of God, although it has been mentioned in several epistles. Since some of these, according to what has been heard, have fallen into the hands of enemies, while others have remained concealed, this servant recounts it again. His reward rests with the One who created him, brought him into being, sustained him, raised him up, taught him, directed him, and guided him to His straight path.

**47** While the Sun of Truth was shining from the horizon of the Land of Mystery, one day they suddenly surrounded the house. It is unnecessary to recount the details now; a brief account is given. For a time they prevented people from leaving or entering. Afterward, however, various groups affiliated with other states came and entered His presence. At every moment the Tongue of Grandeur uttered what the tongues of the world are powerless to recount. The consuls of the states outwardly arose to offer assistance and came into His presence, but God refused to bring about what they intended.

**48** Afterward, Dhabih—upon him be the glory of God, the All-Glorious—arrived, and the Most Exalted Pen began the blessed Surih of the Chief. It was completed during the journey, and He recited it to the official at the seaport. This servant quotes a few of its verses so that perhaps the heedless may become aware, the sleeping awaken, and the dead attain a new life. The matter rests in the hand of our Beloved and your Beloved, our Desire and the Desire of all in the heavens and on earth. His words—exalted be His station, mighty His utterance, and great His glory:

**49** In His name, the All-Glorious.

**50** “O Chief, hear the call of God, the King, the All-Protecting, the Self-Subsisting. He calls aloud between earth and heaven and summons all to the All-Glorious Scene. Neither your grunting, nor the barking of those around you, nor the armies of the worlds can hinder Him. The world has been set ablaze by the Word of your Lord, the All-Glorious. More delicate than the morning breeze, it has appeared in human form. Through it God has brought to life those of His servants who have turned toward Him. Within it is water with which God has purified the hearts of those who have turned toward Him and become oblivious to the mention of anything besides Him, and He has drawn them near to the scene of His Great Name.” Further on He says—exalted be His glory:

**51** “O Chief, you have committed what causes Muhammad, the Messenger of God, to lament in the highest Paradise. The world has so deceived you that you have turned away from the Face whose light has illumined the Concourse on high. You will soon find yourself in manifest loss. You have joined with the chief of Persia to harm Me, after I came to you from the dawning-place of grandeur and majesty with a Cause that brought delight to the eyes of those brought near to God.” Further on He says—exalted be His praise: “Did you imagine that you could extinguish the fire God has kindled throughout the horizons? No, by His own true Self, if only you understood! Rather, through what you have done, its flame and its blaze have increased. It will soon encompass the earth and all who dwell upon it. Thus has the matter been decreed, and the judgment of those in the heavens and on earth cannot withstand it. The Land of Mystery and other lands will soon be changed and pass out of the king’s hands. Earthquakes will occur, wailing will rise, corruption will appear throughout the regions, and affairs will fall into disorder because of what has befallen these captives at the hands of the armies of the oppressors. The government will change, and conditions will grow so severe that \[corrupted original text\] will lament in the hills, the trees will weep in the mountains, blood will flow from all things, and you will see the people in great turmoil.” End of quotation.

**52** O world, is there any hearing within you that will listen? Is there any sight that will see? The Beloved of all existence has spoken in the most wondrous and explicit language. By the Land of Mystery is meant Adrianople, for before the Most Great Prison that land was the seat of the throne, and its numerical value corresponds to that of “Sirr.” He says that the Land of Mystery will be changed, as will its surroundings, and will pass out of the king’s hands; earthquakes will occur, cries and lamentations will rise, corruption will appear throughout the regions, and affairs will fall into disorder. All these calamities are because of the afflictions brought upon these captives by the armies of the oppressors. All these things were seen to occur outwardly, and no fair-minded, truthful, and just person has denied or denies them. He also says, “The government will change,” meaning that the first chief departs and another chief takes his place, as was witnessed. He also says, “Conditions will grow severe”: matters will become so grave that the sand in the hills and mountains, and the trees upon the mountains, will weep, and blood will flow and stream from all things, for there befell the True One Himself what had befallen no one. Then He says, “You will see the people in great turmoil.”

**53** By the life of God, turmoil had engulfed everyone. Muslim troops entered Christian villages, depriving everyone of life—women and men, young and old—and then setting fire to their houses and possessions. This was precisely how the Muslims treated the Christians. Terror had seized everyone, and turmoil had engulfed them all. One traveler wrote, “I passed through a place where, within twenty paces, \[corrupted original text\] three hundred corpses lay piled upon one another. The horror of that sight never leaves my eyes.” In short, you have all heard of that upheaval and know of it, and nothing like it has been seen in any century. Journalists have written things that the mind refuses to accept. Now the people of the Bayán must reflect and know with unmistakable certainty that everything that subsequently occurred had previously been revealed, word for word, by the Most Exalted Pen. Glory to Him who revives bones when they have crumbled to dust, and glory to Him who foretold everything and is all-knowing.

**54** Yet, O beloved of my heart, whose remembrance is in my heart, what has been mentioned is a great glad tiding for the faithful, the chosen, the steadfast, and the fair-minded, but “it increases the wrongdoers in nothing but loss,” for the deaf are deprived of the cooing of the Dove of the Cause, and the blind are barred from the lights of the Most Exalted Horizon.

**55** He also says—exalted be His remembrance, all-embracing His grace, and great His bounty—in the Súrih of the Temple, addressing the King of Paris, these words—glorified be His glory:

**56** “Say: O King of Paris, tell the priest not to ring the bells. By God, the True One, the Most Mighty Bell has appeared in the form of the Most Great Name, and the fingers of the will of your Lord, the Most High, the Most Exalted, ring it in the dominion of eternity in His name, the All-Glorious. Thus have the most great verses of your Lord been sent down \[corrupted original text\] another, so that you may arise to remember God, the Creator of earth and heaven, in these days when all the peoples of the earth have lamented, the foundations of the countries have been shaken, and the dust of unbelief has enveloped all people except those whom your Lord, the Almighty, the All-Wise, has willed to spare.”

**57** Further on He says—exalted be His grandeur: “O King, listen to the call from this Fire blazing in this verdant Tree upon this lofty Mount, in the holy, snow-white Spot beyond the ocean of eternity: ‘There is no God but Me, the Ever-Forgiving, the Merciful.’”

**58** Further on He says—exalted be His utterance: “The Tree of Sinai speaks in the heart of the world, and the Holy Spirit calls out among the nations: ‘The Desired One has come with manifest sovereignty.’” Until

**59** He says—exalted be His station: “O King, We heard a statement you made when the King of Russia questioned you about the decision to wage war. Your Lord is indeed the All-Knowing, the All-Informed. You said, ‘I was asleep in my bed when I was awakened by the cry of the servants who were wronged until they drowned in the Black Sea.’ Thus We heard, and your Lord bears witness to what I say. He testifies that it was not the cry that awakened you, but desire, for We \[corrupted original text\] found you aloof. Recognize the meaning of these words and be among those who discern. We do not wish any word of reproach to be directed at you, out of regard for the station We have bestowed on you in this outward life. We have chosen courtesy and made it the characteristic of those brought near. It is a garment that suits every soul, young and old. Blessed is the one who makes it the adornment of his person; woe to the one who is deprived of this great bounty.”

**60** “Had you been true to your word, you would not have cast the Book of God behind your back when it was sent to you by One who is Almighty, All-Wise. We \[corrupted original text\] through it and did not find you as you claimed to be. Arise and make amends for what you have missed. The world and all you possess will pass away, and sovereignty will remain with God, your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers. You should not confine affairs to whatever your desire inclines toward. Fear the sighs of the Wronged One; protect Him from the arrows of the oppressors. Because of what \[corrupted original text\], affairs in your kingdom will fall into disorder, and sovereignty will leave your grasp as recompense for your actions. Then you will find yourself in manifest loss. Earthquakes will seize all the peoples there unless you arise to aid this Cause and follow the Spirit on this straight path. Has your glory deceived you? By My life, it will not endure; it will pass away unless you hold fast to this firm cord. We see humiliation hastening after you while you remain asleep. When you hear the call from the realm of grandeur, you should cast aside what you possess and say, ‘Here I am, O God of all who are in the heavens and on earth!’”

**61** “O King, We were in the chief city of Iraq until the hour of departure arrived, when We proceeded to the King of Islam at his command. When We reached him, We suffered at the hands of the hypocrites what no pages could fully record. At this the inhabitants of Paradise and the dwellers in the courts of holiness lamented, yet the people remain behind a thick veil. Say: Do you oppose the One who has come to you with God’s clear proofs and His testimony, His evidence and His verses? These do not originate with Him, but with the One who raised Him up, sent Him forth with the truth, and made Him a lamp for all the worlds. Our plight grew more severe every day, indeed every hour, until they brought Us out of prison and, with manifest injustice, cast Us into the Most Great Prison. When asked, ‘For what crime have they been imprisoned?’ they said, ‘They wished to renew religion.’ If what is old is what you prefer, why have you abandoned what was prescribed in the Torah and the Gospel? Consider, O people! By My life, today you have no escape. If this is My crime, Muhammad, the Messenger of God, committed it before Me, and before Him the Spirit, and before Him the One who conversed with God. If My sin is to exalt the Word of God and manifest His Cause, then I am the foremost of sinners. I would not exchange this sin for sovereignty over the kingdom of the heavens and the earth.” End of quotation.

**62** The circumstances of this blessed Tablet are as follows: In the Land of Mystery, a most exalted and holy Tablet was revealed specifically for the King of Paris and sent to him. The reason for its revelation was that the king had made a statement in a public assembly, saying, “We are not here to manage affairs concerning ourselves alone. Rather, if anyone in the world is oppressed and cries out, we answer and recover his rights from the oppressors.” This was the substance of a statement he made. He made another statement in reply to the King of Russia, who had asked him, “You and I both belong to the same religious community. What prompted you to support Islam and ally yourself with it in war?” He replied, “I did not aid Islam. Rather, the cry of the oppressed, whose ships you shattered and sank in the Black Sea, awakened me from sleep, and I arose to put an end to oppression.”

**63** After these two statements were heard, the divine Tablet was revealed. In it He says, “We heard two statements from you on two occasions, from which the fragrance of justice and fairness wafted. If His Majesty the King considers himself a champion of the oppressed of the world, why has he not arisen to aid these oppressed ones, whose like the eye of the world has never seen, even though for successive years their cries have risen from every land? Throughout this time they have been under the scourges of oppression and wrath, so that everyone with eyes has wept and everyone with a heart has lamented. How many lands have been dyed with their blood, and in how many cities have their lamentations, their outcries, and their weeping risen!” In this Tablet, most of the afflictions that had befallen them flowed from the Most Exalted Pen and were revealed.

**64** For some time after it was sent, no reply came. Eventually his minister submitted a letter to this effect: “The foreign minister and I brought your letter into the emperor’s presence and explained the circumstances. He took the letter and laid it beside him, and so far he has given no reply on this matter.” Therefore a second Tablet was revealed from the heaven of the divine will, and a member of the community of the Son who had attained to recognition submitted, “We translated it into French and sent it.” Knowledge rests with God.

**65** This is why He says, “O King, We heard a statement you made when the King of Russia questioned you about what had occurred through the decree of war. You replied, ‘I was asleep in my bed when I was awakened by the cry of the oppressed servants who drowned in the Black Sea.’ We testify that it was not the cry that awakened you, but selfish desire, for We tested you and found you aloof”—that is, standing apart from your word. Further on He says—exalted be His utterance: “Had you been true to your word, you would not have cast the Book of God behind your back.”

**66** He then says, “Because of what you have done, on account of your actions, affairs in your kingdom will fall into disorder, and sovereignty will pass from your grasp as the recompense for your deeds. At that time you will find yourself in manifest loss, and earthquakes will seize all the peoples there. There is no escape from these things unless you arise to support the Cause and follow the Spirit on this straight path.” He also says, “Has your glory made you proud? By My life, this glory will not endure. Soon it will pass away unless you hold fast to the firm cord of God, exalted be His glory.” He then says, “We see abasement hastening toward you from behind, while you are among those who sleep”—that is, you are asleep and unaware.

**67** Now consider: He foretold these events with the utmost explicitness, although most people regarded their occurrence as impossible and inconceivable. For example, someone once asked this servant, “Does this mean that the emperor of Paris will be deposed? How will sovereignty pass from him, and how will his glory fade, when he is the foremost of the world’s kings?” This servant replied, “This servant has no knowledge or information, but I know this much: whatever has been revealed by the Tongue of Grandeur will all come to pass in the most outward reality. You will see and hear.”

**68** In any case, this servant’s purpose in recounting these things is that every group may become informed and aware of the signs and clear proofs of God, and know with certainty that whatever subsequently appeared had already been revealed by the Most Exalted Pen. Since the Tablets to the Kings revealed in the Sūrih of the Temple, as well as the Tablet to the Chief, were in the possession of many people several years before these events occurred, they have been mentioned here. Otherwise, were this servant to recount the manifest signs and brilliant proofs, many volumes would be needed, and some might hesitate to accept them.

**69** In any case, I ask everyone to look upon God with God’s own vision, for all are commanded to do this, and this is particular to this Revelation. The Point of the Bayān—may the souls of all besides Him be sacrificed for Him—says, “See Him with His own eyes. If you look with the eyes of another, you will never attain recognition and understanding.”

**70** Those who associate partners with God have appeared with stratagems and deceit the like of which has never been seen, and He foretold all these things. Blessed is the steadfast person who regards the clamor, insinuations, and doubts of the people of the world as the buzzing of flies. Great is the Revelation, and great is the Cause. I ask God to assist His servants to do what is fitting.

**71** Today the Qurʾān declares in the most eloquent language, “O heedless ones! The Mother Book is speaking, and the horizon of certitude is illumined. The proof shines forth, and the evidence is clear. Do not let conjectures deprive you of the Dayspring of the light of certainty, or let vain imaginings keep you from the Lord of all people.” Utterances like these have repeatedly been heard from the Revealer of the verses. These words were also heard from the Tongue of Grandeur—His words, blessed and exalted be He:

**72** “Today the Bayān calls out with the utmost compassion and loving care, saying, ‘O My people and My companions! Today the Lord of the unseen and the seen is established upon the throne of revelation, and the Mother of the Bayān is manifest. Do not, through conjectures, deny yourselves the sealed wine or deprive yourselves of the river of certainty.’”

**73** On one occasion the Tongue of Grandeur spoke these blessed words: “Even if an eye were as vast as the heavens, should it wish to turn in another direction to a degree too small to reckon, it would not be worthy to enter this court.”

**74** Glory be to You, O You in whose grasp are the reins of meaning and utterance! I ask You, by Your name through which the Sun of Eternity has shone from the horizon of the world, to protect Your chosen ones and Your loved ones from the deceit of those who have disbelieved in You and Your signs and turned away from what You commanded them in Your books, scriptures, writings, and tablets. O Lord, You see Your ignorant servants, who have made deception their weapon and falsehood their refuge and shelter, fabricating against You by night and day things that have caused the dwellers in the pavilion of Your glory and grandeur to lament. O Lord, I ask You, by the lights of Your face and the mysteries of Your Cause, to send down upon them what will acquaint them with, and teach them, Your path and what is with You. You are indeed the All-Powerful, the All-Sufficing, the All-Protecting, the Everlasting, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise.

**75** O friends of God! Make every effort to prevent deluded souls from once again casting the hapless people into the pit of conjectures, as they did before. These are the souls of whom He says—His words, exalted be He: “They exchanged God’s favor for unbelief and settled their people in the abode of ruin.” These are the souls who have always altered the divine bounty and turned people away from the straight path. In the past, during the Qurʾānic dispensation, a few people, driven by selfish desires, made strenuous efforts to lead souls astray. Such people have existed in every age and will continue to exist.

**76** Some papers arrived in these days. Upon examining and reading them, it became clear and evident that they had issued from the very essence of malice and hatred. He has altered some of the divine utterances, which are the true bounty. The serpent has appeared in new colors and, with every show of friendship, has sought to keep the servants from the Most Exalted Horizon, deprive them of the ocean of certainty, and summon them to the pool of delusion.

**77** Say, “O unjust one! Abandon injustice and hold fast to the cord of justice. Where were you when the darkness of oppression enveloped the world and everyone was in hiding for fear of the oppressors’ might?”

**78** A deadly poison lies concealed in the words he has written. For example, at the beginning of his letter he has mentioned the Most Great Name, writing, “In the name of God, the All-Glorious, the All-Glorious. There is no god but Him. Say: All return to Him.” Glory be to God! He has made the name of God a snare for himself and spread a trap. With these words he has sought to put those who are certain, who affirm God’s oneness, and who are sincere at ease, and then make them taste the lethal poison hidden in the fangs of his words. One is bewildered by the trickery and deceit of such people.

**79** Whoever acknowledges these words is free from concern with the talk of the world, the clamor of nations, the sayings of people, and the disputes of the community, for today is the Day of God, in which it is not fitting to mention anything else. This is the Day of which He says, “All things perish except His face.” Today the people of Bahā are aboard the crimson arks, and these vessels move and travel over sea and land. Blessed is whoever holds fast to them, detached from the world, its mention, and all that is in it.

**80** In any case, after mentioning the name of God, exalted be His glory, which he imagines he has made into a trap, the person in question has said things unworthy of mention. He has written of his ascent through the stages of learning: syntax, morphology, semantics, rhetoric, logic, substances and accidents, jurisprudence and its principles, Peripatetic and Illuminationist philosophy, the philosophy of the late Shaykh, and service to Ḥājī Karīm Khān. By mentioning these things he has sought to display his learning, although he has outwardly written, “I understood nothing of these sciences.” If only, for as much time as he occupied himself with writing these words, he had examined God’s verses with divine vision and reflected on the mysteries of divine knowledge and wisdom.

**81** For twelve hundred years the scholars of the Qurʾān wrote expressions of this kind, refuting and affirming one another. Whatever those people reaped from sowing words, and whatever fruit they obtained, these people too will obtain.

**82** In any case, he lies in wait for God’s devoted ones and friends and, through displays of love and kindness and words that neither nourish nor avail, is busy leading the hapless people astray. He has even professed belief in the Tree of the Bayān and written, “Whatever I read of the words of the Point of the Bayān added bewilderment to my bewilderment and opened no door of understanding for me.”

**83** “Not that—God forbid—they do not contain exalted matters. Rather, it is because this Cause, according to the words of the Author of the Bayān Himself, is now at the stage of the embryo. It takes a very exceptional person to understand from the embryo the laws governing all things, outwardly, clearly, perceptibly, and manifestly, or to apprehend the conditions that befall it—except one whom God has taught the knowledge of all things.” These are the words of that heedless person. This humble servant submits:

**84** O people of the Bayān and O people of the Qur’an! The light of the Sun of Revelation has encompassed the world, and its radiance and splendors are manifest and resplendent. The Point of the Bayān—may the souls of all others be sacrificed for Him—says: “A one-year-old embryo in the day of His appearance is mightier than the whole Bayān.” This is the Day that all the Books, Scriptures, and Tablets have ascribed to God, and of which they have given everyone glad tidings. All must turn toward the Most Exalted Horizon with keen eyes and ears sanctified from every mention, and listen to the call raised from the right hand of the Most Great Throne.

**85** Today, anyone who clings to the Bayān and rises in objection is not, according to the testimony of the Point of the Bayān, counted among the people of truth, for He makes all things conditional upon recognition. The essence of the Bayān is this: “He is not to be consulted through My allusion, nor through what has been mentioned in the Bayān.” After this blessed utterance, no fair-minded and discerning person, no perceptive and knowledgeable soul, would use the Bayān to object to God. Has he not heard Him say that the entire Bayān is a leaf among the leaves of the Paradise

**86** of His? It is not clear what that heedless, ignorant person means by what he has said. If he means that the Bayān is now at the stage of the embryo and has not been completed, the Primal Point—may the souls of all others be sacrificed for Him—says, exalted and mighty are His words: “From the beginning of that Cause until the completion of nine, the realities of creation have not appeared. All that you have seen is from the embryo to that which We clothed in flesh. Then wait until you witness the other creation. Say: ‘Blessed, then, is God, the best of creators!’” End of quotation.

**87** Say: “You unfair one! Consider and reflect on what has flowed from the Pen of the Point of the Bayān—may the souls of all in the kingdoms of command and creation be sacrificed for Him. Today is the day of the other creation. Today the tongue of all things speaks the blessed words, ‘Blessed, then, is God, the best of creators!’ He says that through His appearance the Bayān is completed, and states with complete explicitness that before the completion of nine the realities of creation have not appeared, and that all you have seen belongs to the stage of the embryo up to its being clothed in flesh. Wait until you behold the other creation. Say: ‘Blessed, then, is God, the best of creators!’ This is the station of ‘Then it was sounded again,’ to the end of His exalted words.”

**88** Such is the greatness of this Revelation that the Primal Point says, exalted and mighty are His words: “He may reject one above whom there is none on earth, for that one is a creature in His grasp, and all are obedient to Him.” No one understands the greatness of this Revelation except those whom God wills. This vessel needs another mariner, and this sea another diver.

**89** Although all the days of the Manifestations of God and the recipients of revelation are, in one sense, called the Day of God, these days are adorned with the robe of particular distinction, as has been explained in detail. All the words of the idolaters of old have been, and continue to be, heard from the new idolaters in this Revelation. Indeed, they have said what no idolater has ever said.

**90** O people of the Bayān! Fear God, and do not object to God on the basis of your imaginings. He calls you to the light, while you call Him to the fire. Why do you fail to understand a word from God, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise? No one’s knowledge has encompassed this Revelation. All the knowledge of the world is like a drop beside the ocean of His knowledge. Rather, I ask God’s forgiveness for this limitation.

**91** The Expounder of the Bayān—may the souls of all in existence be sacrificed for Him—says, exalted and mighty are His words:

**92** “For after a time there is a Cause for you that you will come to know, and that day is like a time, but you do not perceive. That Tree of Sinai will surely speak to you, if you will listen. Say: ‘It is an Announcement whose knowledge no one will encompass, yet on that day you will not know.’” End of quotation.

**93** According to the testimony of the Bayān and all the divine Books, no one has possessed, or possesses, knowledge of this Revelation. Reflect on the mention of “after a time,” so that perhaps the fragrance of the All-Merciful’s utterance may be inhaled, and those who have gone astray may turn toward the straight path and the Great Announcement, and cleanse themselves of their fabrications with the water of return. Truly, our Lord, the All-Merciful, is the Ever-Relenting, the Merciful.

**94** O beloved of my heart! What can this servant submit, what evidence can he invoke, and what proof can he present? By the life of my heart’s Desire! The very essence of evidence is powerless to describe this path. Glory be to God, beyond what they have said and continue to say! Throughout the centuries and ages, this ignorant rabble has clung to a delusion and risen in dispute. At times, mention of the Qāʾim was the cause of contention; at others, mention of the guardian, the successor, the chief, and the like. On the day of Revelation, the fruit of their discussions, beliefs, and deeds was what they witnessed. “What are these images to which they are so devoted?” If only they had held fast to a single word and professed it sincerely and truthfully! Shame on them and on what their hands have earned!

**95** Today, no art, no science, no name, no rank, and no book can make a person independent or suffice for them, except through what the Tongue of Grandeur has spoken, exalted be His glory: “This is a Day in which the Mother Book speaks and the Mother of the Bayān calls aloud, while the people neither recognize nor perceive. The prophet is one who believes in My Announcement; the messenger is one who conveys My messages; the successor is one who enjoins upon the people the wondrous commandments and laws sent down from My Kingdom; and the guardian is one who bids the people love Me and calls them to My straight path.” End of quotation.

**96** Blessed are those souls whom the people’s doubts and allusions do not keep from, or deprive of, the Revealer of the verses and the Manifestation of clear proofs. All names are created by His word. The Primal Point—may the souls of all others be sacrificed for Him—says, exalted and mighty are His words:

**97** “Through a word He creates whomever He wills—a prophet, a guardian, a supremely truthful one, or a pure one—for all whom He has created are guides from Him and emissaries from His presence.” And further, mighty and exalted are His words: “Beware, beware lest, in the days of His appearance, you be veiled by the Vāḥid of the Bayān, for that Vāḥid is a creature in His presence. And beware, beware lest you be veiled by the words I have revealed in the Bayān.” And further, exalted are His words: “Look upon Him only through His own eye, for whoever looks upon Him through His own eye will recognize Him; otherwise he will be veiled. If you desire God and His presence, desire Him and look upon Him.” End of quotation.

**98** O you who have ears! Speak fairly for less than a moment. According to the testimony of the Point of the Bayān—may the souls of all in the worlds of command and creation be sacrificed for Him—if anyone today argues from the Bayān or clings to it, the Bayān itself and what has been revealed in it by the Most Exalted Pen \[corrupted original text\] disavow. As mentioned before, He says: “He is not to be consulted through My allusion, nor through what has been mentioned in the Bayān.” Today the Bayān is conditional upon acceptance. Blessed are those souls who reflect a little and consider the fruits of the deeds of the people of the Qur’an, so that they may be released and freed from all those sayings, arguments, and objections, and soar in this atmosphere on delicate, sanctified wings. Have they not had enough of the fabrications of the sources of self and desire, that they now wish to set up a fresh controversy, cite traditions, and introduce rejection and acceptance? Say: “With the arm of certitude, tear through the obstructing veils.”

**99** By the life of our Lord! Today He who spoke on Sinai is manifest and speaking, and the hidden secret and treasured mystery are revealed. For a time, some of the people of the Bayān objected to the mention of divinity, asking why God, exalted be His glory, speaks these words, even though throughout the Books He says that on that Day the Self-Subsisting One will utter the words, “Truly, I am God.” Consider, then recall what the All-Merciful has sent down in the Qur’an, blessed and exalted are His words: “The day your Lord comes, or some of your Lord’s signs”; and “The day when the people stand before the Lord of the worlds”; and “Your Lord is brought, and the angels, rank upon rank”; and the like. The Seal of the Prophets—may the souls of all others be sacrificed for Him—says: “You will see your Lord as you see the full moon on the fourteenth night.”

**100** The prophet Isaiah says: “The Lord alone will be exalted on that Day.” Concerning the greatness of the Day, he says: “Enter into the rock and hide in the dust before the terror of the Lord and the splendor of His majesty.” And elsewhere: “The wilderness and the dry land will rejoice, and the desert will exult and blossom like the narcissus. It will blossom abundantly and rejoice with exultation. The glory of Lebanon will be given to it, the splendor of Carmel and Sharon. They will see the glory of the Lord, the splendor of our God.”

**101** Today those with eyes to see behold all the atoms of creation filled with joy and gladness, for what has been foretold from the beginning that has no beginning has appeared. By the life of our Beloved and our heart’s Desire! If a heart contains even less than a needle’s eye of the love of God, or the light of fairness, it will be set ablaze by this utterance with a fire that will enable the world to partake of the warmth of the love of God.

**102** People of Bahá! Leave these weak-willed people of the world to themselves, and with souls ablaze, strong feet and hands, keen eyes, attentive ears, pure hearts, and eloquent tongues, speak, see, and hear, despite those who profess faith in the Bayān yet disbelieve in the One who sent it down, revealed it, and dispatched it. This wilderness mentioned in the blessed verse is the spacious wilderness, and this is the Holy Land mentioned in the earlier Books and the Qur’an. He says: “The wilderness, the dry lands, and the barren desert will rejoice.” Why do this gladness, joy, and delight appear? By the life of our Lord! Because of the coming of the Lord, exalted be His glory. Carmel was mentioned earlier; it is known in the Holy Books as the Mound of God and lies facing Acre, while in another direction are Lebanon and likewise Sharon. In short, all the divine promises mentioned in the revealed Books, earlier and later, concern these lands.

**103** Likewise, the prophet Isaiah says: “Strengthen the feeble hands and make firm the trembling knees.” He says: “Make the feeble hands strong, and the trembling knees firm and steadfast. Say to the fearful of heart: ‘Be strong; do not fear. Here is your God.’”

**104** The essence of this utterance is that, on the Day of Revelation, you should not remain veiled from the blessed words “Truly, I am God,” nor grow faint. Take hold of the Book with strong hands, and arise to serve the Cause with firm and steadfast feet. Friends! Do not let what people possess, or what you yourselves possess, veil you from what is with God. Today is the day of turning toward Him, of affirmation, of “Yes” and “Here I am.” He says—exalted be His glory: “This is not the day for questioning. It befits every soul, upon hearing the call from the highest horizon, to say: ‘Here I am, Lord of Names! Here I am, Desire of all who are in the heavens and the earths!’” End of quotation.

**105** This servant does not know what to say or with what to occupy himself. He feels ashamed to mention these things. The reason for the delay of these pages is that one day the matter was submitted in His presence. He moved His blessed finger and said: “Your Lord needs no evidence, argument, or proof other than Himself. O servant in attendance! Any soul who has caught even less than a needle’s eye of the fragrance of the robe sees all things as evidence, argument, and proof. Blessed is the soul who, with the water of divine love, has cleansed and sanctified himself from the words, deeds, insinuations, and doubts of those who turn away, and has turned toward the highest horizon alone. He is of the people of Bahá, while whoever has been kept back is indeed in manifest error.” End of quotation.

**106** On another occasion, this exalted utterance was heard from the Lord of Names. He said: “O servant in attendance! The Most Exalted Pen proclaims at the loudest call: ‘People of the Qur’an, people of the Bayān, and followers of all religions! Today is the Day of God, and the True One is manifest in His own Person. He has never needed, nor does He now need, anyone else to establish His Cause. If they consider verses a proof, the equivalent of all the divine Books, earlier and later—indeed, more—has descended from the heaven of His will. If they seek clear evidence, let them examine the revealed surahs, so that they may become aware and drink from the ocean of divine knowledge.’ O servant in attendance! Today, until they cross the gulf of names, they will neither enter the Most Great Ocean nor attain its bounty. This is the truth, beyond all doubt.” End of quotation.

**107** This transient servant submits to everyone: Do not spend your days on unseemly objections, unworthy words, and unacceptable deeds. The Cause is exceedingly precious and, in God’s sight, higher and more valuable than all things. It is a great pity to expend something so precious on selfish desires and vain imaginings that neither nourish nor enrich one. Glory be to God! The man from Kirmán has mentioned these branches of learning merely to boast, unaware that he must spend years purifying his heart of each of the things he has written and turn back to the True One.

**108** O world! If you have an ear, listen. The Point of the Bayān—may the soul of all else be sacrificed for Him—says: “If you recite a single verse of the verses of Him whom God will make manifest, it will be more precious in God’s sight than if you transcribe the whole Bayān, for on that Day that one verse will save you, whereas the whole Bayān will not.”

**109** And if an ear can still be found in you, listen to these words of the Point—may the soul of all else be sacrificed for Him. He says, mighty and majestic is He: “I believe in Him, in His religion, His Book, His guides, His paths, and whatever appears from Him, in all this taking pride in my relationship to Him and finding honor in my faith in Him.”

**110** And again, if an ear can be found in you, listen for God’s sake; listen truly, listen fairly, and listen with an attentive ear. He says, mighty and majestic is He: “O all things in the Bayān! Know your own limits, for one such as the Point of the Bayān believes in Him whom God will make manifest before all things, and in this I indeed take pride over all who are in the kingdom of the heavens and the earth.” And He says, mighty and majestic is He: “Do not veil yourself from God after His appearance, for all that the Bayān has exalted is like a seal-ring in my hands, and I myself am a seal-ring in the hands of Him whom God will make manifest.” And He says, exalted be His mention: “You, the numbers of the First Váḥid, and all that God, exalted be His glory, enumerates—God has made you only as a seal-ring in the hands of Him whom God will make manifest, exalted be His mention. He turns it however He wills. He is indeed the All-Protecting, the Most Exalted.” And He says, exalted be His station: “He makes those on earth prophets, so that they will indeed be prophets in God’s sight.” And He says, blessed and exalted is He: “On the day of the appearance of Him whom God will make manifest, all who are on earth are equal before Him. Whoever He makes a prophet has been a prophet from the beginning that has no beginning to the end that has no end, for this is something God has ordained. And whoever He makes a saint has been a saint in all the worlds, for this is something He has ordained.”

**111** Glory be to God! Consider the provisions of the true Disposer and the heedlessness of us servants! There is no counsel He has not given, and no provision He has not sent down. He has spoken words that cause everyone with sight and everyone with a heart to lament and mourn, for from His words appear worlds upon worlds of sorrow, and from His utterance worlds upon worlds of grief and anguish. He says, exalted be His glory: “He, exalted be His mention, is like the sun: if an infinite number of mirrors were to face Him, they would all reflect the sun’s radiance according to their capacity. And if none faces it, the sun still rises and sets; the veil belongs to the mirrors. I have spared no effort in counseling these people and providing for their turning toward God on earth. Then my being rejoices when all have reached the summit of their existence, attained the countenance of their Beloved, and apprehended all that is possible in the contingent world of the revelation of their heart’s Desire. Otherwise my heart grieves, for I have nurtured all things for this. How, then, can anyone remain veiled? For this I have called upon God, and I will surely call upon Him. He is near and answers.”

**112** Despite the provisions of the true Disposer and utterances that split the heart of a mountain, these people remain firmly in their old error, except those whom your Lord wills.

**113** Gentlemen and friends of God! Listen with the ear of your soul to the lamentations of the Point, and likewise to the mysteries of His Book, and reflect on the manifestations of His providence, His testing, and His trials. May my soul be sacrificed for His loving care, His mention, His providence, His counsel, and His testing! He says: “Do not make the Bayān and what has been revealed in it the measure by which to recognize that true Sun.” And He says: “He is not to be consulted through my indication.” He is not made known by my indication, nor by what has been revealed in the Bayān. Elsewhere, counseling with words of warning, He says: “Beware, beware lest you veil yourself through the Váḥid of the Bayān.” The Váḥid of the Bayān occupies the position of the Imams of the past, as He Himself states in the Persian Bayān. Indeed, He says that the bodies of these Letters occupy the station of the spirits of the Imams of the past. Nevertheless, He says: “Do not let these Letters veil you from that Sun of Truth.” And repeatedly He says in words of warning: “Do not let the verses revealed in the Bayān veil you from Him.”

**114** I swear by the Sun of the horizon of meanings! In various passages these utterances have flowed from His blessed Pen, as some of them have already been cited and are coming before the eyes of the friends of God, who are attaining them. Despite all these counsels, reminders, and explanations, He tested everyone by mentioning the single word “Mustaghāth.” Yet the word “Mustaghāth” belongs to the Bayān, and He says: “Do not let the whole Bayān veil you from Him.” Through this slight test He found everyone brought to a standstill. At this moment it was as though the Herald of grandeur called out at the top of His voice from the horizon of the kingdom of the All-Merciful’s utterance, saying: “Now the truth has become manifest, and the falsehood of those who profess belief in the Bayān yet disbelieve in the One who revealed and sent it down has been exposed.”

**115** If only they had been content to remain at a standstill! Some, with the arrows of aversion, some with the spears of denial, and others with drawn swords, have striven and still strive to cut down the blessed Tree. The Revealer of the Bayān explicitly foretold this, saying: “They will not consent to grant that Tree, neither of the East nor of the West, even the name of believer; for if they consented, they would not bring sorrow upon Him.” Since recounting these matters gives rise to sorrow, this mortal does not venture to speak further of them.

**116** Glory be to God! All are deluded, bewildered, and tested by the single word “Mustaghāth,” even though He also stated the following and forbade them to cling to it. His words, exalted is He: “For no one knows of the Revelation except God. Whenever it takes place, all must acknowledge the Point of Truth and offer thanks to God.” This is the truth, beyond all doubt.

**117** Today the books of the world cannot serve as a veil or a hindrance, and everything depends upon and is subject to the word of God, exalted be His glory. You who have ears, hear the call of the Desire of all peoples, who has called out and continues to call out before the eyes of the world from the beginning of the Cause until now. In one of the Tablets this exalted utterance appeared from the Cleaver of the Dawn. His words, all-embracing is His bounty: “Today is the day of sight, for the Most Exalted Horizon is radiant, and the day of hearing, for the call of God is raised at every moment.” End of quotation.

**118** Friends! What have these heedless souls imagined? If they remain deprived of the kingdom of divine verses and the heaven of divine Revelation, with what will they console themselves and consider themselves believers? Today, according to the explicit text of all the Books, whoever looks to anyone other than God alone has been and will be among those who have gone astray. To this bear witness the Books of God, the All-Protecting, the Self-Subsisting.
